scope: Actual demo-call capture, human/known-fixture review, serial single-call replay; not a benchmark
changes: Private bounded asynchronous exact-request audio/context and model-output capture
Completed/cancelled/error status, explicit truncated-output flag, session/turn/input IDs and trace join
CLI list/label/replay; no inferred gold labels, no overwritten human reviews
Demo-only opt-in config, visible privacy status, loopback API archive health
No change to routing prompts, four-state semantics, speculative scheduling or playback rules

real_browser.input_source: self-authored synthetic fixture; not user conversation

real_replay.expected_source: Known complete self-authored question, not the observed prediction

limits: Actual request WAV is after the input evidence filter, not raw dual-channel room audio
Output is before playback and may be unplayed; TTS text proof is not acoustic-fidelity proof
Queued or in-flight cases may be lost on hard termination; .partial cases are not published
512 MiB / 2000-case automatic quota; explicit replay reports are outside automatic capture quota
No physical listening, full turn-timing replay, formal latency comparison or RB evaluation
No user audio or private case archive is committed; no integrity hashes computed
